_readme: Emergency lever for released builds. Edit this file on the gh-pages branch (GitHub web UI works) and the change reaches every app on next launch, with no store release. All three fields are optional; an empty object means nothing is wrong.
_minVersion: Builds strictly below this are blocked with an update screen. Use only for a genuinely unsafe build — a wrong dose, a broken calculator. Example: "1.2.1"
_disabledTools: Tool ids taken out of service; those screens show a notice instead of the tool. Example: ["tpn-calculator"]
_notice: Message shown at the top of the app. Example: "Correction issued for TPN dosing — please update."
